item.title: Oracle: Board Expanded With Appointment Of Former Quest Diagnostics Chief Stephen Rusckowski
item.description: Oracle Corporation has added longtime healthcare and technology executive Stephen Rusckowski to its Board of Directors, expanding the Board to 14 members as the company continues to strengthen its leadership bench during a period of significant growth in cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, and healthcare technology. The election became effective on November 18, 2025.

item.title: Trive Capital Forms Vendor Management Platform Through Investment In Illumis Global
item.description: Trive Capital has made a strategic investment in Illumis Global to accelerate the company’s expansion and establish a comprehensive vendor management platform serving enterprises across multiple industries. The investment brings together Illumis’ long-standing expertise in accounts payable recovery audits and business intelligence with Trive’s growth resources and operational capabilities.

item.title: Deblock: €30 Million Series A Raised To Accelerate European Expansion
item.description: Deblock, a fintech startup building fully on-chain financial infrastructure, has raised €30 million in a Series A funding round that will support its expansion across Europe and accelerate its product development efforts.

item.title: Baker McKenzie: Miles Wadley Named As New Head Of Project Finance In Melbourne
item.description: Baker McKenzie has expanded its Australian Banking and Finance practice with the appointment of Miles Wadley as the new Head of Project Finance in Melbourne. Wadley, formerly a partner at Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer, brings extensive experience across infrastructure, energy, and complex financing transactions. His hiring follows a series of strategic additions across the firm’s financial and energy practices throughout 2025.

item.title: ExxonMobil To Buy 40% Stake In Enterprise’s Bahia NGL Pipeline
item.description: Enterprise Products Partners announced a significant transaction with ExxonMobil, which has agreed to acquire a 40 percent undivided joint interest in the midstream operator’s Bahia natural gas liquids pipeline. The deal, expected to close by early 2026 pending regulatory approvals, positions the companies to jointly expand one of the Permian Basin’s newest large-scale NGL transport systems.

item.title: LPL Financial Takes Minority Stake In Private Advisor Group
item.description: Private Advisor Group announced that LPL Financial has acquired a minority ownership stake in the firm, marking a significant expansion of one of the longest-standing relationships in the wealth management sector. The agreement strengthens Private Advisor Group’s strategic alignment with LPL Financial, one of the fastest-growing wealth management platforms in the United States. It adds to the existing minority ownership held by Merchant Investment Management.

item.title: Eros Innovation: $150 Million In New Funding Raised
item.description: Eros Innovation has completed approximately $150 million in new capital and strategic transactions as it advances toward becoming a global AI-driven media and entertainment company valued at $2 billion. The announcement details a mix of primary investment and major acquisitions that expand the company’s content, technology, and cultural intelligence infrastructure.

item.title: Giga Energy: Interview With Co-Founder & CEO Matt Lohstroh About The Fast-Delivery Electrical Infrastructure Company
item.description: Giga Energy manufactures transformers, switchboards, and modular power systems that provide the foundations for reliable electrical infrastructure. With factories in Long Beach and Houston, Giga Energy delivers high-quality solutions with industry-leading lead times to power data centers, renewable energy, and industrial applications. Pulse 2.0 interviewed Giga Energy co-founder and CEO Matt Lohstroh to gain a deeper understanding of the company.

item.title: Hunt Capital Partners Launches $277.1 Million Affordable Housing Fund Covering 10 States
item.description: Hunt Capital Partners has announced the launch of a $277.1 million multi-investor Low-Income Housing Tax Credit fund to create and preserve 1,540 affordable homes across 10 states. The initiative, known as Hunt Capital Partners Tax Credit Fund 52, has secured $175.3 million to date, with the remaining commitments expected to be finalized in the first quarter of 2026.

item.title: HubBox: £6 Million Raised To Expand Global Out Of Home Delivery Network
item.description: HubBox has secured £6 million in new growth funding to accelerate its international expansion and strengthen its position in the out-of-home delivery sector. The funding round was led by Puma Growth Partners, which focuses on scaling established, high-growth companies. The capital will support HubBox as it broadens its footprint across the United Kingdom, Europe, Japan, and the United States and enhances its partnerships with couriers while onboarding additional retailers.
